name: What factors influence the cost of soft close drawer installation?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of soft close drawer installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of soft close drawer installation is influenced by several factors. These include the number of drawers being converted or installed, the type and quality of soft close slides chosen, and whether it's a new installation or a retrofit. Labor costs vary based on the complexity of the job, such as modifications needed for existing cabinetry. The overall project scope and any additional repairs or carpentry work will also impact the final price.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost factors include the number of drawers, type of slides, new installation vs. retrofit, and labor for modifications.
